examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A standard data-driven table: pass `:data` and `:columns` and the engine renders sortable headers, status `Tag`s and per-row action menus, and `DataTablePagination` in the `footer` slot pages the rows. The table has no outer border by default; set `bordered` to draw one.

examples.name: WithCheckboxes
examples.summary: A leading selection column (`selectable`): each row gets a checkbox and the header gets a select-all box that reflects the all/none/indeterminate state. Selection is exposed via `v-model:selected-keys`.

examples.name: CompactHeader
examples.summary: A denser table via `density="compact"`, which sets the header and the rows: the column-header row and the body rows use a reduced height and padding, so the table opens straight onto that header row.
